svg.title: Last-write on a quiet page and on a busy one
svg.desc: Two last-write questions on lesson 09's recording, each drawn as a strip of stretches of 1,000 instructions from tick 0 on the left. Top: last-write of g's own bytes at 78,112, on page 19, asked at tick 299,502. Only 1 stretch is replayed, the one holding the write at tick 69,152 in call 0; every later stretch is skipped because page 19 stayed the same object in its two snapshots. The search runs 1,000 instructions, and moving to the write 152 more. Bottom: last-write of g + 40 at 65,944, on page 16, asked at the start of call 301, tick 303,864. Page 16 is copied by every snapshot, so every stretch back to the write at tick 191,487 in call 147 is replayed: 113 stretches, 112,864 instructions, and moving to the write 487 more.
svg.text: the run from tick 0 on the left, in stretches of 1,000 instructions
the pointer g, at 78,112, on page 19
then 152 to move to the write: 1,152 in all
asked at 303,864, the start of call 301
then 487 to move to the write: 113,351 in all
